usage: cli.py brief [-h] --as-of AS_OF --prices PRICES
                    --prices-meta PRICES_META --filings FILINGS
                    --filings-meta FILINGS_META --catalysts CATALYSTS
                    --catalysts-meta CATALYSTS_META --out OUT
                    [--meta-out META_OUT] [--render-md RENDER_MD]
                    [--cache-dir CACHE_DIR] [--cache-only] [--refresh]
                    [--no-clobber]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --as-of AS_OF         As-of date (YYYY-MM-DD)
  --prices PRICES       Prices CSV path
  --prices-meta PRICES_META
                        Prices meta JSON path
  --filings FILINGS     Filings JSONL path
  --filings-meta FILINGS_META
                        Filings meta JSON path
  --catalysts CATALYSTS
                        Catalysts JSONL path
  --catalysts-meta CATALYSTS_META
                        Catalysts meta JSON path
  --out OUT             Output brief JSON path
  --meta-out META_OUT   Optional output brief meta JSON path
  --render-md RENDER_MD
                        Optional output brief markdown path
  --cache-dir CACHE_DIR
                        Cache directory
  --cache-only          Fail if cache is missing; do not recompute.
  --refresh             Recompute even if cache exists.
  --no-clobber          Fail if output file already exists.
